title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - NotifyingFunction
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/NotifyingFunction. A function that allows a device to notify about some relevant activity, e.g. that a threshold value has been exceeded or that an object has moved (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.4). Subclass of saref:Function; parent of CommunicatingFunction. notificationTrigger is added for a usable candidate model, grounded in the ontology's own definition.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'NotifyingFunction'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

notificationTrigger.description: Property. Free-text description of the condition that triggers the notification, e.g. 'heart rate above 180 bpm'.
